bundle.shortDescription: Local-first addiction and habit recovery tracker
bundle.longDescription: deUrge is a private, offline recovery tracker. Log urges, habits and sessions, watch your streaks grow and understand your patterns — without ever creating an account or sending data anywhere. Everything is stored locally in a single SQLite database on this device; the app never touches the network.
